title: 第19章 长生第20章 大方师毋恙求追读
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
“第三步当如何？”
嬴政的心瞬间提到嗓子眼。
强烈的预感告诉他，这第三步才是真正的关键核心，也是横亘在长生之路上的最大天堑。
嬴政只觉得自己的心跳，都要随着邹云的停顿而停止。
邹云抬起头幽幽长叹，目光似乎穿透了宫殿的穹顶，望向了那冥冥不可知的所在。
这叹息声中蕴含的凝重，让整个大殿的温度都仿佛骤降几分。
就连嬴政也能清楚的感知到，邹云接下来要说的，似乎才是真正的禁忌。
一股莫名的，深入骨髓的寒气不知从何处悄然弥漫开来，让嬴政不由打了个寒颤。
“这第三步，本应求取昆仑瑶池之主——西王母娘娘，赐下那传说中的无上神物凤凰胆！以此护住真灵不灭。”
说到这里，邹云刻意停顿了一下，也不忘给石公他们打个补丁。
“这也是石公等人，踏遍三山五岳，远赴海外，苦苦追寻的所谓长生不老药之一。”
随即，他缓缓摇头，脸上浮现出一丝无力愧疚。
“然仙山缥缈，瑶池更是难觅其踪。便以我的微末道行，穷尽心力，也......也实在没有把握能够寻到。”
他的话语中充斥的不确定性，如同一盆冰水，将嬴政眼中炽热彻底浇灭。
不过，没等嬴政将失落的神情浮于表面。
“但——！”
邹云话锋一转，又将他的心给提了上去。
“我有一法，可替之。”
掷地有声的话语，让嬴政生平第一次，体会一把过山车的魅力。
就如同溺水者抓住的最后一根浮木，嬴政猛地抬头，眼中爆发出前所未有的疯狂光芒！

什么九五之尊，什么千古一帝，这时都被抛到九霄云外。
他再也顾不得什么帝王威仪，猛地从御座上站起，对着阶下邹云，竟以一个几乎只有弟子侍奉师长父母时才会有的姿态。
双掌交叠，重重俯首，行了一个至恭至敬的大礼。
“还请邹师教我！！！”
-----------------
殿外。
赵高如同一尊石雕，亲自守候在门外，只有微微颤抖的指尖，方才透露着他内心的炽盛欲望。
殿内，那若有若无的对话声，如同带着魔力的咒语，断断续续地钻进他的耳朵。
虽然听得不甚分明，如同隔着一层浓雾。
但其中夹杂的“长生”、“仙法”、“替代”、“金缕玉衣”、“凤凰胆”、“由死向生”......
这些如同带着魔力的词眼，却像烧红的烙铁，狠狠烙印在赵高心尖。
长生！
content_en:
"What about the third step?"
Ying Zheng's heart suddenly rose to his throat.
A strong premonition told him that this third step was the real key and the biggest obstacle on the road to immortality.
Ying Zheng felt that his heartbeat would stop as Zou Yun paused.
Zou Yun raised his head and sighed deeply, his gaze seemed to penetrate the dome of the palace, looking towards the unknown place.
The solemnity contained in this sigh made the temperature of the entire hall seem to drop sharply.
Even Ying Zheng could clearly sense that what Zou Yun was about to say seemed to be the real taboo.
An inexplicable cold air that penetrated into the bone marrow quietly spread from nowhere, making Ying Zheng shiver.
"In this third step, I should ask the Queen Mother of the West, the owner of Kunlun Yaochi, to give me the legendary supreme divine object Phoenix Gallbladder! This will protect the immortality of the true spirit."
Speaking of this, Zou Yun paused deliberately, not forgetting to patch Shi Gong and the others.
"This is also one of the so-called elixirs of immortality that Shi Gong and others traveled all over the mountains and overseas to pursue."
Immediately, he shook his head slowly, with a trace of helplessness and guilt on his face.
"However, the Immortal Mountain is elusive, and the Yaochi is even more difficult to find. Even with my humble skills, I have tried my best, but... I am really not sure that I can find it."
The uncertainty in his words was like a basin of ice water, completely extinguishing the heat in Ying Zheng's eyes.
However, Ying Zheng didn't wait for his disappointed expression to surface.
"But-!"
Zou Yun changed the topic and raised his heart again.
"I have an alternative."
The powerful words made Ying Zheng experience the charm of a roller coaster for the first time in his life.
Just like the last piece of driftwood caught by a drowning man, Ying Zheng suddenly raised his head, his eyes bursting with unprecedented crazy light!
The greatness of the Nine-Fifth Five-Year Plan, the one emperor of the ages, were all thrown out of the sky at this time.
He no longer cared about the majesty of the emperor, and stood up from the throne suddenly, facing Zou Yun at the foot of the stairs, with an attitude that was almost only seen when a disciple serves his master's parents.
He folded his palms, bowed his head heavily, and made a most respectful salute.
"Please ask Master Zou to teach me!!!"
------------------
Outside the palace.
Zhao Gao was like a stone sculpture, personally waiting outside the door. Only his slightly trembling fingertips revealed the burning desire in his heart.
In the hall, the faint sound of conversation penetrated his ears intermittently, like a magical spell.
Although I couldn't hear it clearly, it was as if I was separated by a layer of thick fog.
But mixed with it are "immortality", "immortal magic", "replacement", "golden jade clothing", "phoenix courage", "from death to life"...
These words were like magical words, but like a red-hot iron, they were branded on Zhao Gao's heart.
Immortality!
